functions.name: fn_801BDE7C
functions.divergence: The recovered resource lookup, endian decoding, two packet formats, scaling paths, dispatch, and state flag update compile as honest C, but GC/1.2.5n emits a 596-byte body instead of retail's 600-byte body. It selects a 104-byte frame instead of retail's 72-byte frame and a different saved-register set, schedules endian assembly differently, and uses compiler-local floating constants and conversion sequences rather than retail's exact constant relocations and register allocation.
